FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Events Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a couple of useful new fields to the Event def.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds targetAllSettlements field to FCEventDef. If true, the event targets all valid settlements
Adds serialized list of permanent stat modifiers to WorldSettlementFC, so that settlements can track permanent stat modifiers that aren't attached to buildings or events
Adds permanentStatModifiers field to FCEventDef. Listed modifiers will be permanently applied to all settlements affected by the event

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Event Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Minor fix to the display of event options.

patchNoteLines.li: Show permanent stat modifiers for each event option alongside the temporary ones
